status: SOURCE_ONLY_DESIGN; no implementation, candidate source, R1 publication or execution
selectedDirection: A private opt-in timing projection from the same existing combined PowerShell invocation into the same invocation's existing bounded censusReads row. This is diagnostic evidence for choosing a later repair, not a performance repair itself.
unchangedOriginalWork: One fresh existing system PowerShell interpreter, then one original four-property Win32_Process command and one original Get-NetTCPConnection command in the same sequence.
Both complete original query strings, CreationDate/UTC/integer/executable projection, listener selection, original two data strings and their existing parsers remain byte-exact.
No new process, native query, CDP/RPC read, census, observation reuse, persistent interpreter, native handle, action, signal, timer, polling iteration or deadline is introduced.
Every original controller/driver/Main identity, lineage/orphan/listener/renderer guard, full census cap, three original HANDLE witnesses, two UI Stops, Quit and cleanup remains authoritative.

prospectiveSchema.defaultWire: The existing no-diagnostic callers retain exactly {processes:string,listeners:string}. processes(), listeners(), cleanup evidence and every unrelated caller remain unchanged.
prospectiveSchema.optInWire: The P08-only opt-in permits exactly the original two string keys plus processPipelineMs and listenerPipelineMs. Each new key is null or an integer0..30000; no PID/path/command text/credentials or arbitrary object is copied.
prospectiveSchema.clock: Use protected System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp/Frequency arithmetic immediately before and after each unchanged whole pipeline. Clock/type/conversion failures produce null only; keep the query statements outside all diagnostic catches.
prospectiveSchema.powerShellSerialization: Insert the two nullable primitive fields into the already existing outer envelope serialization. No second original query or second process-data serialization is needed; the process pipeline already contains its original projection/ConvertTo-Json.
prospectiveSchema.unknownBehavior: Missing, malformed, nonfinite, negative, out-of-range, fractional or otherwise refused diagnostic fields become unknown. Do not coerce or clamp them into valid durations. Preserve original rejection of malformed data strings and all unrecognized extra data-envelope keys. The exact opt-in closed-key compatibility requires a separately published R1.
prospectiveSchema.publicReturn: windowsProcessListenerSnapshot still returns only its existing {processes,listeners} data shape. A private protected observer may receive only the validated primitive timing pair after the original data parsing succeeds.
prospectiveSchema.callerJoin: The Gate holds timing primitives only in the same synchronous read closure. observeCensus projects them into the row already appended for that invocation; do not correlate by PID/time heuristic, mutate an earlier row, use a global last-value cache or replay a read.
prospectiveSchema.trace: Keep the existing512-row cap, truncated flag and original startMs/endMs/returned fields. Timing values are passive; no validator, remaining(), action or pass/fail branch may consume them.
prospectiveSchema.boundsLimit: This bound is for the proposed fixed timing object alone, not the complete receipt. Added clock, arithmetic, allocation and output bytes consume the original budgets and transport capacity.

distinguishableAndUnknown.processPipelineMs: Elapsed time for Get-CimInstance plus its original CreationDate filtering, per-row projection, UTC conversion, inner ConvertTo-Json and pipeline/materialization work. It is not a pure native CIM timer.
distinguishableAndUnknown.listenerPipelineMs: Elapsed time for the original Get-NetTCPConnection plus its original port filter and OwningProcess projection. It includes any module/adapter work performed in that pipeline; no narrower share is proved.
distinguishableAndUnknown.wholeRead: Retain the existing Node observeCensus interval for the complete synchronous read, which also includes interpreter startup/teardown, outer JSON formatting, transport, decoding and parsing.
distinguishableAndUnknown.unmeasuredResidual: Subtracting the two child intervals from the overall Node interval gives only an approximate remainder across distinct clocks and boundaries. Do not call it startup, formatting or provider time; do not clamp a negative remainder or promote it into authority.
distinguishableAndUnknown.separatingMore: A pure-CIM-versus-projection split would require splitting/interposing into the original pipeline and reviewing its materialization/error ordering. An outer-format-only measurement would require another output/protocol arrangement. Neither expansion is selected for this bounded design.
distinguishableAndUnknown.failedRead: If a query fails, times out or output is partial, the original read still throws and existing returned=false is retained. Metadata may be absent; no recovery, query retry or new output sink is proposed.

errorAndOutputLimits: Diagnostic publisher/getter/projection failures must not replace the original result or the same thrown executor/parser object. Instrumented PowerShell line locations may change diagnostic stack text; byte-identical script error formatting is not claimed.
Protect only clock and timing projection work, never the original queries or data parser. The existing PowerShell ErrorActionPreference=Stop and original executor timeout remain unchanged.

Do not add a stderr line: pinned Node24.21 execFileSync forwards captured child stderr through process.stderr before returning/throwing. A new line would introduce another output/outer-PowerShell interaction and would need a separate reviewed correlation/partial-write contract.
No promise that diagnostic output survives a process timeout, hard kill, transport failure or final-receipt failure. Added work can consume the same remaining budget.

sameCimClassQuestion.documented: Microsoft Get-NetTCPConnection documentation names its output as root\StandardCimv2\MSFT_NetTCPConnection; the class documentation describes LocalPort uint16, OwningProcess uint32 and State2 Listen, with Windows8/Server2012 minimum. Get-CimInstance supports that namespace/class and filters.
sameCimClassQuestion.notDocumentedByTheseSources: These references do not establish complete equivalence of the exact installed cmdlet's no-match/provider-error/adapter behavior, permissions, enumeration or timing when bypassed with direct Get-CimInstance. The installed NetTCPIP CDXML implementation was not retained in this artifact.
sameCimClassQuestion.disposition: No direct-CIM replacement is selected. Same class identity alone is insufficient to claim unchanged original negative oracles or a performance gain.

primarySources.scope: Original execFileSync return/throw and inherited stderr forwarding implementation; no Node code executed.
Official cmdlet signature/output class; bytes bound to this read, not a pinned runner module.
Official class schema/Listen value/support; not implementation or timing equivalence.
Counter primitive definition; no local/runtime measurement.

prospectiveValidationBoundary: Current privacy original177/24 GREEN must be retained before any separately authorized diagnostic source publication/application.

A future exact source/R1/R2 must cover platform, Gate and their original existing helper tests/source pins. Static tests must execute the actual helper/observer seams, preserve all existing malformed-envelope/foreign/stale/cap/deadline assertions, and distinguish diagnostic unknown from acceptance.
Only the existing original CI route is available. No local test/compiler/lint/install/native venue, extra benchmark, side workflow or retry is authorized.

Any future diagnostic-only RED demonstrates absent timing retention, not the native timeout or a performance correction. Only the original resulting-source Windows journeys can provide actual timing and all original acceptance/cleanup evidence.
This assessment creates no source file or test candidate and does not authorize implementation.
